comments.author: @henrischomäcker
comments.text:
I really appreciate your videos and do not miss one.

But I would be really thankful if you would also always inform your viewers, especially the non professionals, that if you are including those third party services in your website, you should and in Europe MUST also include a disclaimer that the data inserted into the third-party-service formfields will be send to at least two other third-party companies which will process the data.
If you miss that disclaimer in Europe, you may get sued and will have to pay a very high penalty which may break you neck!

I also miss a notice that you shouldn't use AI services just to send an email address from a formfield on your website to your own email account.
There are plenty of free wordpress plugins that do that, from simple to complex.
Using AI for tasks where AI is not needed for is not a responsible use of our world's resources.
If everybody now would use AI just for what it's not needed for, several new datacenters would have to be build and consume lots of energy just for submitting email addresses to a hobbyist website owner.

Always use AI in a responsible way!
